title: NyxCore: TinyML Watchdog for micro-ROS (Research Prototype)
description: An independent ESP32 watchdog that monitors a robot's DDS streams and keeps reporting when the main compute node stalls: if a topic goes silent for 3 s it forces an ERROR state on its own. Anomaly scoring runs in pure C with no ML runtime, a Mahalanobis scorer plus a 31-parameter (124 B) autoencoder compiled into firmware, shipped as a managed micro-ROS lifecycle node on FreeRTOS. Research prototype: the S3 is the paper target, testing runs on ESP32 and ESP32-C6, and model constants are synthetic placeholders until field calibration, so there is no accuracy claim yet.
